svg.title: Sam independently compares Maya’s key before approving it
svg.desc: Maya keeps her private key and publishes a public profile and signed message. Sam verifies the message, compares the entire fingerprint with Maya through an independently trusted channel, then approves the exact key in Sam’s browser. A mismatch stops approval.
svg.text: Fictional participants. No private key is shared.
The board contains her public profile and signed message.
Her private key stays with her, outside the shared board.
Sam checks the message and current key
“Signature verified” checks the bytes. The key is still unapproved.
Select Maya → read the displayed full fingerprint.
Sam compares it with Maya independently
Use an established call or an in-person conversation.
Compare every character with Maya’s own trusted setup.
Repeating a fingerprint in the same board is not a separate check.
Approval applies in Sam’s local browser.
Do not approve or weaken policy.
A replacement key needs another review. CLI trust is separate.
